name: pasopkan
description: Pasopkan monorepo: frontend/ (web app) and backend/ (API). Each has its own package.json and node_modules; this file only forwards commands.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
